page_note: Page is dominated by systematic substrate teaching about the five enthumeses (faculties) — taste, touch, heart — describing how each functions as storehouse/cellarer receiving impressions and returning them on demand. The king-and-senators and cellarer similes are internal to the cosmological-psychological mapping, not pointing outside the system. Voice is impersonal-structural throughout. No editorial seams, no audience address, no institutional vocabulary. Last three lines are physical lacunae.
